change_policy: Business definitions. Do not override via environment variables. Changing any value requires a new dated entry in docs/decisions_log.md and a version bump.

dc_charger.rule: charger_id has >=1 identified port whose max peak_power_kw across the data exceeds the threshold

unbound_attempts.definition: blank port_id on a DC charger

site_resolution.site_key: normalised upper(street_address) + '|' + upper(city) of the matched AFDC record

visit.gap_definition: session_start - previous session_end at the same site

kpi.name: First-Time Charge Success rate (FTCS)
kpi.formula: visits whose first attempt succeeded / all visits
